WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60. The talent order is Icy Veins' published Arms levelling build (page dated November 4), checked against the live tree. Level-60 builds are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's, named where they differ. Numbers are the client's unless a source is named. Anything marked (WoWSims' model) is what a simulator's rotation list does at 60, not a measured result. Its combat-log measurements are named as measurements. No raid is open until December 9, so nothing here is raid-tested. Hover tooltips can show the wrong rank, so where one differs from the prose, believe the prose.

What Arms is for

Killing two enemies at once with one heavy weapon. Sweeping StrikesSweeping StrikesTalentCastInstantCost30 RageCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration20 secYour next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. makes your next 5 melee attacks also strike a second enemy. Before it, the spec runs on RendRendLevel 4 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost10 RageRangeMeleeDuration9 secWounds the target causing them to bleed for 15 damage over 9 sec. and OverpowerOverpowerLevel 12 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost5 RageRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownInstantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 5. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.. After 31, BloodthrillBloodthrillTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantGrants your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend a 20% chance to allow an activation of Overpower. lets your swings open Overpower on any target carrying your Rend.

Icy Veins recommends Protection for levelling and calls Arms "a good alternative if you prefer using a two handed weapon". Wowhead's Arms page says the spec struggles with several enemies at once without a healer and is "phenomenal" in dungeons and elite quests. Kargoz prefers Arms from level 10 for its early two-target damage and the two-handers that dungeon quests hand out; that is one creator's report.

Deals an additional 75% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted. fills gaps. Icy Veins puts it above Mortal StrikeMortal StrikeLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost30 RageRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secA vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec. against Giants, Dragonkin and mounted targets, and otherwise saves it for when Rage is about to cap.

Stat priority

Weapon damage first. A slow two-hander: Mortal StrikeMortal StrikeLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost30 RageRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secA vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec., SlamSlamLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5Cast1.5 sec castCost15 RageRangeMeleeCooldown15 sec cooldownSlams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16. and WhirlwindWhirlwindLevel 36 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 RageCooldown10 sec cooldownIn a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy. all take their base from the weapon's hit, and Rage is normalized to weapon speed.

At 60 the two sites nearly agree. Icy Veins: weapon DPS, Hit, Expertise, critical strike, Strength. Wowhead: Hit to 8%, Expertise to 6.5%, critical strike, Strength, Agility, Haste, and it labels its list speculative for endgame. Expertise is new in Forever and reduces enemy dodges and parries. While levelling you rarely get to choose: take the weapon upgrade, then Strength and Hit.

On WoWSims' pre-raid Arms set, one point of weapon DPS is worth about 17.6 Attack Power and one Strength 2.2 (WoWSims' model).

At level 60

Dungeons are the level-60 game until raids open on December 9. Icy Veins describes Arms at 60 as cleave-first: strongest against two nearby enemies, with sustained damage limited by Rage. No raid log exists, and neither site ranks the build against Fury on measured data. Wowhead's tier list predates launch tuning and calls itself a prediction.
